profile.name: ASI MS2000显微镜控制器
profile.description: 用于显微镜自动化的多轴控制器，可驱动X、Y、Z载物台或调焦轴，并在部分配置下控制LED照明通道。常用于显微成像中的样品定位、扫描、对焦以及光源联动控制。
profile.description_en: A multi-axis controller for microscope automation that can drive X, Y, and Z stage or focus axes, and on some configurations also control LED illumination channels. It is commonly used for sample positioning, scanning, focusing, and coordinated light control in microscopy experiments.
